propositions: Reconciler read and check paths currently call load_config() and inspect environment/cwd, allowing configuration scope to change during operation execution
Jira backend properties can reload ambient settings, discarding the supplied registry configuration and changing read scope
Cut over reconcile-check and dry-run paths to use immutable ReconcilerSettings, GitRuntime, and BridgeRuntime projections with exactly one selected Jira backend per operation
Backend project/query scope, TLS, timeout/limits, tracker layout, and auth capability must remain stable throughout the operation regardless of subsequent environment or file mutations
Secret carriers and authentication properties must exclude static sensitive fields from repr/equality/hash/cache/fingerprint while unwrapping only in the selected Jira sending adapter
